learning_outcomes.text: Students will learn the common characteristics and orbital mechanics of orbits used by communication satellites and other research satellites.

Students will learn to understand the characteristics of the propagation channel in communication between ground station and satellite and between satellites, and antenna design compatible with satellite communication systems.
Students will learn to perform precise link budget calculations for satellite communication and other wireless communication systems.
Students will gain knowledge about satellite communication and geostationary satellites.
Students will grasp the importance of satellite communication in the daily communication world.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to satellites and satellite communication
Satellite orbit types and LEO, MEO, HEO, GEO type orbits
Space environment, satellites, and satellite subsystems
Modulation and multiplexing approaches in satellite communication
Error control approaches in satellite communication
